title: Sour Album Cover
coreRelationships: The subject's direct gaze and expression create a confrontational yet playful mood.
The vibrant stickers on the face contrast with the otherwise simple background and clothing, drawing attention to the facial expression.
The 'SOUR' text on the tongue is a central, unexpected element that communicates the album title directly and unconventionally.
The solid purple background provides a clean, consistent backdrop that allows the subject and her adornments to stand out.
reuseFormula: Recreate a medium shot portrait of a young woman with long dark hair, adorned with numerous colorful stickers on her face. She should have her tongue extended with individual letter beads spelling 'SOUR' on it. The background must be a solid, vibrant lavender. Include a 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' label in the bottom right corner.
